title: Pagero for Invoice Management: How Its E-Invoicing Network Compares With Billtrust and Corcentric
summary: Key Takeaways Pagero handles e-invoicing compliance across 70 countries and serves 86,000 customers, with a 2% churn rate and 84% CSAT. Teams running AR automation report cost savings of up to 80%. One global food and agri conglomerate cut invoice cycle time by over 70% and hit 99% error-free transactions. Mandates are active or close in Belgium, Poland, France, and India, so e-invoicing is a legal requirement in those markets, not a preference. Penalties run from Rs 10,000 to Rs 25,000 in India and up to €15,000 per year across several EU countries. Pagero’s marquee deployments run full AR automation in far fewer countries than it validates. Hewlett Packard Enterprise covers 29 of the 70 supported. E-invoicing networks kill manual re-keying by passing validated, structured documents straight from sender to recipient. Why E-Invoicing Went From Optional to Mandatory In much of the world, e-invoicing stopped being optional. It is law now, and the numbers explain why buyers care. Evaluate an AP/AR automation vendor like Pagero on invoice management, and you are looking at compliance coverage across 70 countries with real-time schema validation, 86,000 customers, a 2% churn rate, and 84% CSAT. Those figures show the model works at scale.
